Window types / W-03

Picture windows

Glass set straight into the narrowest frame we make. With no sash in the way, it gives the most glass for the opening, and the best insulation value.

Estimate online Request a quote
Operation
Does not open
Frame depth
82.6 mm · 3 1/4"
Frame edge to glass
41.6 mm · 1 5/8"
Glass
Dual or triple pane
Profile section

How it is built

A picture window has no sash: the glass unit sits directly in a slim welded frame, about 1 5/8" from the edge of the frame to the glass.

The glass is set from the room side and held by a glazing bead, so it can be replaced without taking the frame out.

Where it fits

  • Living rooms and anywhere the view matters
  • Large openings and stair landings
  • Between casements or above an awning, where one unit should stay shut

Glass

  • Double or triple pane sealed units
  • Low-E coatings, argon fill
  • Warm-edge spacer bars
  • Tempered glass where code requires it
  • Obscure / frosted glass for bathrooms
  • Internal grilles in several patterns

Frame & hardware

  • White, or laminated exterior colours and woodgrains
  • Multi-point locking hardware
  • Integrated screens
  • Brickmould, jamb extensions and nailing fin to suit your wall
  • Custom sizes and shapes
